method: Live GitHub pull listing, both 100-item pages
For 127/127 PR heads, compare commit ancestry to pinned IR21 HEAD
For all 105 nonancestor PRs, list complete changed path names, obtain PR-head and integration recursive Git blob trees and compare changed paths byte-for-byte
For 17 unique candidate PRs, inspect PR review submissions (none APPROVED); additionally review 915 and blocked 869
No new source or installation approval inferred from draft labels or green CI

blockedRelease.p02: 2/7 acceptance gates; real two-owner JWT/Chrome outstanding

requirementsBeforeSourceImport: Owner-approved exact target PR and SHA; no inference from OPEN/DRAFT
File-exclusivity review and independent adversarial critic
Inspect head/base/current versions and enforce single integration writer
Preserve original contracts and provider/tenant safety, no SQL/migration without separate DBA approval
Targeted test first, then full IR21/PG17/Chromium source CI; unverified output stays WIP
No P03 execution or production activation until P02 accepted; no main merge/deployment without separate owner release approval
classificationCaveat: SUPERSEDED_OR_DUPLICATE_PROVISIONAL is NOT proof of functional equivalence. Divergent source path changes must be reviewed before archival/closure; unique candidacy is not authorization to integrate.
